subject: maths
question: A work can be finished in a day by 20 men, or by 30 women, or by 50 boys. 2 men and 5 boys work on alternate days and 6 women work on all days. If men work on the first day, the work is finished in ___________ days.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of days taken by 1 man, 1 woman, and 1 boy = LCM(20, 30, 50) = 300 units.

Efficiency: 1 Man = 15, 1 Woman = 10, 1 Boy = 6.

Day 1 Work (2 Men + 6 Women) = 2 × 15 + 6 × 10 = 90 units.

Day 2 Work (5 Boys + 6 Women) = 5 × 6 + 6 × 10 = 90 units.

Since exactly 90 units of work are completed every single day, Total days = 300 ÷ 90 = 10/3 = 3 1/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 1/3 days.**
